messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Well, i had no choice, my heart and soul was into it.

output.original_text: Well, I had no choice, my heart and soul was into it.
output.joy: Well, I absolutely had no choice, my heart and soul were overflowing with joy for it!
output.sadness: Well, I felt I had no choice, my heart and soul were so deeply invested in it, yet it hurts.
output.fear: Well, I had no choice; I was terrified because my heart and soul were so deeply into it.
output.anger: Well, I really had no choice, and it infuriates me because my heart and soul were so invested!
output.surprise: Well, I had no choice; I was shocked because my heart and soul were unexpectedly so into it!
output.disgust: Well, I had no choice, and it disgusts me how my heart and soul were dragged into it.
